problem_plain: Shionogi needed to improve G&A efficiency in its shared-services entity covering HR, general affairs, accounting and finance, while integrating pharmacovigilance operations into a more comprehensive business process management approach.
capability: Joint venture formation with business process managed services, indirect-function reform, ERP application and infrastructure outsourcing
scale_outcomes: 80% of Shionogi Business Partner transferred; effective July 2023
reusable: Indirect-function reform methodology for G&A efficiency; business process management services for drug-safety operations; strategic integration of IT strategy, digital talent development and infrastructure outsourcing
summary: Shionogi formed a joint venture with Veridane Japan by transferring 80% of its consolidated shared-services entity, effective July 2023, applying Veridane's indirect-function reform know-how to drive G&A efficiency. The JV consolidated Shionogi Pharmacovigilance Center to create synergy with Veridane's business process managed services for drug-safety operations, extending a 2017 strategic agreement on IT strategy, digital talent and ERP outsourcing.
